<parameter=code>
def blocks(fr):
    out=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N':

removed=0

    bl=blocks(current_frame)

        break
    if i%8==7: print('iter',i,'step',current_frame.step,'blocks now',len(blocks(current_frame)))
print('final: step',current_frame.step,'level',current_frame.level,'removed',removed,'blocks',len(blocks(current_frame)),'score',last_action_result.get('score'))
</parameter>
